description: UnionBest step 10 MMR cross-port golden pin (MMR-2). Read by Swift UnionBestMMRCrossPortFixtureTests.swift and Rust union_best_mmr_parity.rs. A full-hydration unionBest matrixAware recall at limit 3 under the default lane budget over four near-duplicate bodies (the query plus one trailing word each) and eight diverse bodies that carry the query terms in different phrasing. The pool (12) exceeds the 2N working view (6), so the greedy MMR decides which candidates enter the view; the shingle term, scaled by the step 8.5 redistribution factor (COL-2), penalises the second, third and fourth near-duplicates out of it. expected_content_order was produced by the Swift build with the whole-record vector column out of the fused score by default (Encoder Rerank Program: RecallShape.defaultWeight gives signal:vector 0; the locus column is out of text-query scoring since COL-1) and is asserted verbatim by both ports. Pin history: before COL-1 the order was [query body, '... outage review', 'a deploy day ...']; after COL-1 and COL-2, with the vector column still in the fused score, the third slot was 'for the payments service, a release deploy checklist that tracks certificate expiry and secrets rotation' (the vector column ranked it above 'a deploy day ...'); with the vector column out the third slot is 'a deploy day ...' again on bm25 alone and the near-duplicates stay out, so the move is the fused-score composition (the vector tie-break is gone), not the MMR. Mutation controls: the integrated COL-1 tree (similarity term unscaled) returned [query body, '... deploy today', '... deploy again']; a build with the similarity term zeroed returns the query body and its three near-duplicates as one tie group.
